description: Move a row of an ordered list, such as an incident severity or a monitor status, to another row's place in it, as dragging it in the OneUptime dashboard does: it lands just above that row when it comes from below, just below it when it comes from above, and the list is numbered from the top again. Returns each row whose number changed. An update_ tool's write of the number places only that row and moves no other.

id.description: ID of the row to move.

placeOfId.description: ID of the row whose place it takes, in the same list.

name: oneuptime_move_in_list
title: Move Row in List
